card.fact_statement: Police found a 262-word handwritten document on Luigi Mangione when they arrested him.
card.source_span: The police also said that when they arrested him, they found a 262-word handwritten document (which many media outlets characterized as a "manifesto") partly about the American healthcare system.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni kitu gani chenye maneno 262 ambacho polisi walikipata kwa Luigi Mangione walipomkamata?
